imageCompressor.title: Compress images to the size you need
imageCompressor.subtitle: Shrink JPG, PNG, and WebP files with precision. Set quality manually or choose a KB/MB target — everything runs on your device.
imageCompressor.dropHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or GIF · up to 50 MB per file
imageCompressor.pasteHint: You can also paste (Ctrl+V) from the clipboard.
imageCompressor.qualityHint: Lower it if the file is still too large. 70–85% is usually the best balance for photos.
imageCompressor.targetHint: The tool finds the best quality and resolution that lands at or below your target.
imageCompressor.resizeHint: Images will be scaled down to fit these limits. The aspect ratio stays intact.
imageCompressor.stripExifHint: Always on — metadata such as location and camera details is stripped when the image is re-encoded.
imageCompressor.settingsLocked: Settings are locked while a run is in progress.
imageCompressor.emptyBody: Add images above to start compressing.
imageCompressor.targetMissedHint: Best result is {size} at {width}×{height}px. Try a larger target, WebP, or a lower resolution.
imageCompressor.targetBiggerHint: The target is larger than the original file — it already meets the limit.
imageCompressor.previewHint: Drag the divider to compare quality.
imageCompressor.pngNote: PNG is lossless: quality cannot be lowered. For a much smaller file, choose WebP or JPG.
imageCompressor.heicNote: HEIC is not supported in every browser. If it fails, convert it to JPG first.
imageCompressor.clearConfirm: Remove all images from the queue?
imageCompressor.targetInvalid: Enter a target between 1 KB and 50 MB.
imageCompressor.resizeInvalid: Enter a width or height of at least 16 px.
imageCompressor.qualityAutoNote: Automatic mode uses around 80% quality to keep photos sharp.
imageCompressor.unsupportedBrowser: This browser does not support Web Worker compression. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari.
imageCompressor.noSavingsHint: The result is not smaller than the original. Try WebP, a lower resolution, or a larger target.

imageResizer.title: Resize images with precision
imageResizer.subtitle: Change image dimensions with a locked ratio or custom size. Perfect for passport photos, application forms, and social media.
imageResizer.uploadHint: One image · JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or GIF · up to 50 MB
imageResizer.qualityNote: Quality applies to JPG and WebP.
imageResizer.invalidDims: Width and height must be between 16 and 8000 pixels.
imageResizer.note: Upscaling does not add new detail. For upload limits, reducing resolution is usually better than over-compressing quality.

imageConverter.title: Convert images between formats
imageConverter.subtitle: Change JPG, PNG, and WebP files without uploading. Pick a target format and set output quality for JPG or WebP.
imageConverter.uploadHint: One image · JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or GIF · up to 50 MB
imageConverter.qualityNote: Quality only affects JPG and WebP.
imageConverter.notePng: PNG preserves transparency and is great for text or illustrations, though files tend to be larger.
imageConverter.noteJpeg: JPG does not support transparency; transparent areas become white. It is the smallest option for photos.
imageConverter.noteWebp: WebP offers small files with good quality and supports transparency in modern browsers.
imageConverter.sameFormat: Choose a format different from the original image.

imageCropper.title: Crop images for what you need
imageCropper.subtitle: Select any area with a free ratio or passport presets. Cropping runs in your browser and the result is ready to download.
imageCropper.uploadHint: One image · JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or GIF · up to 50 MB
imageCropper.instruction: Drag a corner or edge of the selection box to set the crop area.
imageCropper.note: Use a 3 × 4 or 4 × 6 ratio for passport-style photos, then double-check the exact size requested on the form.

pdfCompressor.title: Compress PDFs at the level you choose
pdfCompressor.subtitle: Reduce PDF size right in your browser. Pick a quality level, follow per-page progress, and download without uploading.
pdfCompressor.dropHint: One or more PDFs · up to 100 MB per file
pdfCompressor.warningBody: To reduce size significantly, each page is converted to a JPEG image. Text can no longer be selected or searched, and links are lost. Keep the original if you still need to edit it.
pdfCompressor.levelHighDesc: Smallest size, reduced detail and sharpness.
pdfCompressor.noGain: The result is not smaller. Try the High level or use PDF Size Reducer for a target.
pdfCompressor.note: Large PDFs are processed page by page to keep memory safe. You can cancel at any time.
pdfCompressor.emptyBody: Add PDF files above to get started.
pdfCompressor.clearConfirm: Remove all PDFs from the queue?

pdfReducer.title: Reduce a PDF to your target size
pdfReducer.subtitle: Set a size limit in KB or MB. The tool steps down resolution and JPEG quality until the result approaches the target.
pdfReducer.targetHint: Common presets for application and job portals.
pdfReducer.warningBody: This process re-renders pages as JPEG so size can drop aggressively. Text can no longer be selected, and links are lost.
pdfReducer.targetMissedBody: The {target} target could not be reached. The smallest result possible is {size}. Try a larger target, remove pages, or use a document with simpler images.
pdfReducer.note: The smaller the target, the longer the process. You can cancel at any time.
pdfReducer.targetInvalid: Enter a target between 1 KB and 100 MB.

pdfOrganizer.title: Clean up PDF pages in one view
pdfOrganizer.subtitle: Delete unwanted pages, reorder with drag and drop, and rotate scanned pages. Then optimize or download as a new PDF structure.
pdfOrganizer.dragHint: Drag cards to change the order. Every control is also keyboard accessible.
pdfOrganizer.minPage: At least one page must remain.
pdfOrganizer.qualityKeepDesc: No re-rendering. Text stays selectable and links are preserved; size reduction is usually modest.
pdfOrganizer.qualityHighDesc: Sharp re-render with moderate size savings.
pdfOrganizer.qualityBalancedDesc: Decent quality with a smaller file.
pdfOrganizer.qualitySmallDesc: Smallest output, ideal for archives or uploads.
pdfOrganizer.warningBody: Re-rendering turns pages into images, reducing size but making text unselectable. Choose Keep original structure if the document still needs to be edited or searched.
pdfOrganizer.reorderedNote: The new order and rotation are applied when you press the optimize button.
pdfOrganizer.removeAllButOne: One page remains — you can rotate it or replace the PDF.

pdfMerge.title: Merge PDFs in the order you choose
pdfMerge.subtitle: Combine two or more files into one PDF. See each name, size, and page count, set the order, and download — all locally.
pdfMerge.dropHint: Two or more files · up to 100 MB per file
pdfMerge.emptyBody: Add at least two PDFs to start merging.
pdfMerge.orderHint: Reorder with drag and drop or the up and down buttons. All controls are keyboard accessible.
pdfMerge.minFiles: Add at least two valid PDF files.
pdfMerge.note: Merging preserves original text and page structure. The result order follows the list above.
pdfMerge.duplicate: A file with the same name and size is already in the list.

errors.unsupportedImage: Unsupported image format. Use JPG, PNG, WebP, BMP, or GIF.
errors.imageTooLarge: The image is larger than 50 MB.
errors.imageDecode: The image could not be read. It may be corrupted or unsupported by this browser.
errors.unsupportedBrowser: This browser does not support image processing in a Web Worker.
errors.unsupportedFormat: This browser does not support the chosen output format.
errors.canvasFailed: The image canvas could not be created.
errors.encodeFailed: The image could not be saved.
errors.pdfTooLarge: The PDF is larger than 100 MB.
errors.pdfPassword: This PDF is password protected. Remove the protection first, then try again.
errors.pdfCorrupt: The PDF is corrupted or invalid and cannot be read.
errors.minPdfFiles: Add at least two PDF files.
errors.maxFiles: The file limit has been reached.
errors.busy: Wait for the previous process to finish.
errors.resizeInvalid: Invalid dimensions. Use values between 16 and 8000 pixels.
errors.workerCrashed: Processing stopped in the browser. Reload the page and try again.
errors.readFailed: The file could not be read. Please choose it again.
errors.targetUnreachable: The target cannot be reached within reasonable quality limits.
errors.pdfEncryptedSave: This PDF restricts access. Save an unprotected copy first.
